exposure: intravenous dexamethasone (0.2 mg/kg, max 16 mg) after spinal anesthesia
intravenous normal saline (control) prior to spinal anesthesia
cohort: 198 patients undergoing caesarean section with spinal anesthesia were divided into two groups: 98 received dexamethasone and 100 received normal saline.
finding: Intravenous dexamethasone significantly reduced postoperative pain after spinal anesthesia during caesarean section, but had no discernible effect on post-dural puncture headaches or other complications such as bradycardia, nausea, vomiting, shivering, or postoperative hypotension.
